# PursuitField

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/pursuit.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/pursuit.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

World context of the pursuit fixture: its parameters and counters.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `params` | `PursuitParams` | the Pursuit system's parameters: field, chasers, runners, catch_radius, speed, sprint, turn_rate, stamina_drain, stamina_gain, chaser_decisions, runner_decisions, runner_every, alive_reward, others, runners_still, approach_reward |
| `windows` | `uint64_t` | decision windows observed (PursuitObserve) (default 0) |
| `catches` | `uint64_t` | catches since the start (Pursuit) (default 0) |
| `births` | `uint64_t` | runners born after one ended (Pursuit) (default 0) |

## Notes

Emplaced by Pursuit in preinit; read by PursuitObserve. PursuitParams (same header) holds the defaults listed on the Pursuit page.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: Pursuit, PursuitObserve. Created by: Pursuit. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | preinit, tick | emplaced with the parameters; catches and births counted |
| [PursuitObserve](../systems/PursuitObserve.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | tick | parameters read; windows counted |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md)**
  - Entity creation and destruction: every runner's end destroys its entity and creates a new one (a new agent id).
- **[PursuitObserve](../systems/PursuitObserve.md)**
  - On a trainer RESET every dot entity is destroyed and new ones are created.
